visualCharacteristics.structure: centred pill tab bar above a full-width iframe (single iframe when only one row)

contentPattern: Third-party (Euroland) widgets referenced by URL: one row per widget, cell 1 tab label (e.g. 'Stock Quote', 'Price Lookup', 'Share Calculator'), cell 2 iframe URL link, optional cell 3 height in px. One row renders a plain iframe; more than one row renders an accessible tab bar switching iframes. Iframes are created lazily (near viewport, on first tab show) and titled from the label.
